Choose one visible creature within 12 squares. Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition. Make a Basic Ranged attack as part of this action. If it hits, the target is marked for one day with the glowing dust of a cave mushroom. While marked, you and each ally who can see it gain 2 Boons to any attack against it, ignore partial cover from it, and the target cannot hide. The mark deals no additional damage.
